name: Website Support Chat Widget
purpose: A chat widget embedded on the company marketing site that answers visitor questions using a language model.

consequential_actions.description: Responds to website visitors in natural language on behalf of the company

unknowns: Jurisdiction of the visitors was never recorded — the site is publicly reachable but the operator has not stated which markets it serves

Whether chat transcripts are retained, and for how long, is not recorded
